name: Reality Cyclone
description: A damaged device unleashes a blast of magical energy, which coalesces into a cyclone that degrades reality.
disable: DC 17 Arcana or DC 17 Nature (trained) to diffuse magical energy, DC 18 Crafting or DC 18 Computers (trained) to shut down the device, DC 17 Occultism to stabilize reality, DC 18 Thievery (trained) to destabilize the cyclone, or Dispel Magic (2nd rank; counteract DC 16) to counteract the cyclone
routine: (2 actions) The cyclone moves up to 30 feet toward the nearest living creature, then churns in place, degrading reality. All living creatures within 10 feet of the cyclone are dealt 1d8 Acid Damage damage, or 2d8 Acid Damage damage if the cyclone is in their space (Basic DC 20 Reflex Saving Throw save).

offensiveAbilities.name: Form Cyclone
offensiveAbilities.description:
Trigger A living creature disturbs the debris in area A2

Effect A cyclone of magical energy forms around the triggering creature, dealing 2d8 Acid Damage damage (Basic DC 20 Reflex Saving Throw). This cyclone is 5-feet in diameter and 20-feet high. The trap then rolls initiative.
